channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Brain age gap may reliably predict dementia progression
item.description: Brain-predicted age difference (brain-PAD) is a robust predictor of dementia progression, consistent across two estimation methods.

item.title: New metric shows how inequality can spark epidemics despite low overall risk
item.description: Influenza spreads in crowded settings, Ebola when hospital beds are scarce. A new metric explains such outbreaks despite low average risk.

item.title: Endometriosis diagnosis linked to long-term mental health burden
item.description: Women later diagnosed with endometriosis use more antidepressants and anxiety medication and have more mental health contact.

item.title: Immunosuppressive Rxs in Children: Infection Risk Screening
item.description: Changes in immunosuppressive therapies for children and their increased use highlight the need for infection risk screening.
